ResearchProjectDef.label: Archotech Fundamentals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Attempt to grasp a hold of information pertaining to the use of archotech components
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the advanced sensor arrays and systems now available to you, you begin to understand what Starway was trying to hide. The data reveals itself to be studies and research into the manifestations of the entities known as Archotechs. Starway had tried and failed to understand how the technology behind their creations worked.

You sense that more data could possibly unveil some of these grand mysteries to you. In the same way you would throw a dart at a target, you could possibly try to recreate some of the ancient technology. In time.

Gameplay Effect: Quest Sites and Faction Bases will have Ancient Terminals scattered around. Destroy them, and you might find something...
